document.title: "On the Situation in 'A'"
document.authors: Konstantin Chernenko (handwritten, for Politburo/CPSU Central Committee)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Soviet Invasion of Afghanistan, 1979: Not Trump’s Terrorists, Nor Zbig’s Warm Water Ports | National Security Archive
document.note: Hand-written one-pager scribbled by Chernenko at a small meeting in Brezhnev's office on December 12, 1979 (Andropov, Ustinov, Gromyko, Suslov, Brezhnev). It became the resolution sending Soviet troops to Afghanistan, showing Andropov's leading role and the lack of wider Politburo debate. From Fond 89, released 1992; CWIHP Bulletin Fall 1994.

sources_cited: CC CPSU Politburo Protocol 176/125 of 12 Dec 1979 (Resolution No. 997-op)
key_claims: On 12 Dec 1979 the CC CPSU Politburo, chaired by Brezhnev, ratified measures on the situation in 'A' (Afghanistan) drafted by Andropov, Ustinov and Gromyko.
The three were authorized to make non-essential amendments during execution, while questions needing CC decisions were to go expeditiously to the Politburo.
Andropov, Ustinov and Gromyko were solely entrusted with executing the measures and reporting progress to the Politburo.
The resolution is a one-page Top Secret 'Special File' document; the substance of the measures is not stated in it.
Politburo members signed it in the days after the session, with signatures dated 25-26 December 1979.
